request.digest: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; exact current-session live original, or an admitted recovered quiet root in complete_project
request.aliases: retain requested and actual identities; reject duplicate actual originals

forecast_scope.retained_continuation_custody: select the ordinary root; expand its exact linear continuation chain with an optional verified recovered prefix followed by current owned live stages, at most eight committed stages including root; wrappers cannot be selected separately

source.model: one discarded MemoryAdapter clone with existing original obligation runtimes
source.admission: current world plus complete retained original source union, reserve snapshots and owned competing receipts before clone; repeat derived-source admission
source.complete_project_originals: every root and retained descendant requires its exact retained sealed source; root stock-ledger identity/generation stays stable while each child ledger validates its own source-bound plan; sources, archives, receipts, reserve snapshots and predicates join the complete union before cloning
source.recovered_complete_project: ordinary durable recovery captures exact sealed-source anchor, qualified ledger, canonical records/bytes and ordinary source structural bytes/work; query charges their complete union with current/original/reserve sources and performs no archive reads or history hydration
source.recovered_reserve_endpoint: existing exact retained endpoint snapshot must already be present in bounded session history; otherwise refuse without hydration or replacing its first truth; an explicit selected wait may load previously published endpoint evidence

progression.tracked: all current-session open actions in original commit order
progression.other_owners: already-dispatched physical work evolves; their deferred actions are not polled
progression.first_round: zero modeled ticks when horizon positive
progression.prune: terminal and physically quiet actions; retain original receipts
progression.new_project_stage: complete_project only: at most three hypothetical successors per selected root
progression.hypothetical_stage_order: ready actual original digests ascending; defer qualified tracked active-output conflicts while other ready originals proceed; existing and modeled action polls retain commit order
progression.active_output_conflicts: only the exact compiler-qualified canonical producer with matching tracked Active physical work may defer; bounded ordinary polling and recompile from observed stock; no future-output credit or new stage/action charge; untracked, unknown and other errors refuse
progression.new_stage_deadlines: own separately reviewed compiler-derived obligations; no original obligation is renewed
progression.retained_stages: reuse original live action receipts and obligation runtimes or verified recovered historical steps without preparing or recommitting; predecessors already Verified and physically quiet; final live stage may have prepared or active work
progression.recovered_originals: immutable verified historical steps; no ActionIds, restored handles, original polls, stability resets or deadline renewal; current quiet physical identities checked on every private frontier

outcome.group_completion: all selected original goals true, required exact reserve samples true, original actions Verified and physical work quiet at one same modeled frontier
outcome.complete_project: all selected semantic goals and each root/retained pursuit exact reserve true; root, retained and hypothetical actions Verified and physically quiet at the same frontier
outcome.retained_stages: parent-ordered real plan identities with exact source anchors, unchanged obligations, independent reserve samples and predicted outcomes; live action identities use custody already_committed_original; historical steps have no handles and use custody recovered_verified_original; recommitted_by_forecast false
outcome.recovered_originals: complete exact original step rows, action_id null, verified_recovered_history state origin, original source/receipt/proof anchors and deadlines; historical steps count toward completion and action limits; hypothetical successors remain separate

authority.deferred_effects: original current grants and scope checked at modeled dispatch; no new grants
authority.recovery_only: complete_project only: exact recovered prefix, every historical step already Verified and physically quiet; each stage retains complete archived source and the same accepted recovery frontier; optional current-session live descendants must be sealed at or after that frontier; current_stage still refuses
authority.future_stages: modeled Observe, Query, Plan, every effect scope/risk and checkpoint checked before charging or preparing the model stage
continued_project_refusals: gapped, cyclic, branched or duplicate lineage
changed typed root request or source family
foreign live stages, recovered stages after live stages, withdrawn or restore-abandoned custody
missing exact stage source, plan, commit or action custody
failed, cancelled, indeterminate or unknown physical stage work
cross-fortress, unaccepted cross-epoch or backward source lineage
recovered stages with different accepted recovery frontiers or malformed present live receipts

bounds.output: lossless full or compact Agent Turn; otherwise explicit refusal
bounds.hypothetical_costs: root, retained, competing and model actions share negotiated action/entity ceiling; all original archives and modeled plan archives share complete source byte allowance
bounds.recovered_original_steps: root and descendant historical steps share original/competing/hypothetical action ceilings even without live ActionIds; descendant counts also appear in retained_continuation_actions and verified_recovered_continuation_steps

publication.complete_project_next_step: explicit selected wait targets the latest admitted committed tip per root; reserve_endpoint_pursuits lists each independent exact sample obligation; capture remaining samples by zero-tick selected waits of at most eight pursuits at the original endpoint before advancing again
